network.unknownHost: that address isn't known on this network
network.tooBig: the server's answer is too big
network.connectionFailed: the connection to the server failed

server.stoppedByAdmin: Playback was stopped by the server's administrator
server.signedOut: you were signed out: sign in again
server.unreadable: the server's answer can't be read: is it Pley, and up to date?
server.check: {{reason}} Check that the server is on and that this device is on its network.

signIn.tooOld: this server is too old for this app
signIn.noCodes: this server can't sign in TVs with a code yet: update it
signIn.widerScope: the server allowed more than this app asks for: signed out
signIn.unencrypted: this server's address isn't on your network and its connection isn't encrypted: open it by its https address to sign in
signIn.unknownApp: this server doesn't know Pley's TV apps yet: update it
signIn.busy: too many TVs are signing in here right now: try again in a minute
signIn.codeSpent: this code doesn't work anymore: get a new one
signIn.unreadable: the server's answer can't be read: try again
signIn.approveElsewhere: this server sends people to another address to approve TVs: Pley doesn't
signIn.signInElsewhere: this server sends apps to another address to sign in: Pley doesn't
signIn.callsItself: this server calls itself {{address}}: open it by that address, or check the proxy in front of it passes Host
signIn.unreachable: the server can't be reached: check its address and that it's on

oauth.invalidClient: the server doesn't know this app
oauth.unauthorizedClient: the server doesn't let this app sign in this way
oauth.invalidScope: the server refused what this app asked for
oauth.invalidRequest: the server didn't understand the request
oauth.unsupportedGrantType: the server doesn't take this kind of sign-in

profiles.throttled: too many wrong PINs: try again in a few minutes
profiles.pinLocked: This profile's PIN is locked after too many wrong tries. Its owner or an administrator can reset it.
profiles.needsPassword: This profile needs its password: sign in again to use it.
profiles.notAllowed: You can't switch to this profile.
profiles.cantSwitch: This sign-in can't switch profiles: sign in again to allow it.
profiles.ticketSpent: This cast can't switch profiles any more: cast it again.
profiles.signedOut: You were signed out: sign in again.

connect.badAddress: Enter an address such as nas, 192.168.1.20 or pley.example.com.
connect.notPley: Something answers at {{address}}, but it isn't Pley.
